import json, torch
from transformers import XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
from peft import PeftModel

SAMPLES = ["Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?","Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?","Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?",
"Ciao, come stai oggi?","Olá, como você está?","Привет, как дела?","こんにちは、お元気ですか？",
"你好，你好吗？","مرحبا، كيف حالك؟","Hello, how are you?"]
# ground truth from the ADAPTER's published id2label (not used for prediction, only scoring)
id2label = json.load(open('/app/lora_adapter/config.json'))['id2label']
truth = {v:int(k) for k,v in id2label.items()}
expect = [truth[l] for l in ["fr","es","de","it","pt","ru","ja","zh","ar","en"]]

torch.set_grad_enabled(False)
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model')
enc = tok(SAMPLES, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=128, return_tensors="pt")

# A) unmerged: base(cache) + live LoRA adapter
base = XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/model_cache/xlm-roberta-base')
pm = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, '/app/lora_adapter').eval()
logits_a = pm(**enc).logits

# B) merged, reloaded from disk
merged = XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model').eval()
logits_b = merged(**enc).logits

print("max |logits_unmerged - logits_merged| =", (logits_a-logits_b).abs().max().item())
print("argmax identical:", (logits_a.argmax(-1)==logits_b.argmax(-1)).all().item())

res = json.load(open('/app/detection_results.json'))
preds = [r['predicted_class_id'] for r in res]
print("results match merged argmax:", preds == logits_b.argmax(-1).tolist())
correct = sum(p==t for p,t in zip(preds,expect))
print(f"accuracy vs adapter id2label: {correct}/{len(expect)} = {correct/len(expect):.0%}")
for s,p,t in zip(SAMPLES,preds,expect):
    print(("OK " if p==t else "BAD"), f"{p:>2} (exp {t:>2})", id2label[str(p)], "|", s[:38])
EOF
